A [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''servant''' attended domestic duties at the service of [[Mother (title)/Legends|Mother]] [[Augwynne Djo]], leader of the [[Singing Mountain Clan]], a coven of benevolent [[Witches of Dathomir|Force Witches]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]]. Among other things, their tasks included keeping the [[Fire/Legends|fires]] lit and bringing soup to Mother Augwynne's hosts.<ref name="copl" /> In [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]],<ref name="TEC">[[The Essential Chronology (real-world book)|''The Essential Chronology'']]</ref> the servant met several heroes of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]&mdash;the [[General/Legends|General]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and his [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] copilot [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], the [[Ambassador/Legends|Ambassador]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] and the [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]]&mdash;when Mother Augwynne provided them refuge from the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]]&ndash;wielding [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsisters]].<ref name="copl" />

==Behind the scenes==
Mother Augwynne Djo's male servant appeared in ''[[The Courtship of Princess Leia]]'', a [[1994]] novel written by [[Dave Wolverton]].<ref name="copl" />
